NC Leader Aga Ruhullah to Resign as Srinagar MP

National Conference leader Aga Ruhullah is reportedly set to resign as the Member of Parliament for Srinagar on November 3. Reports indicate his resignation stems from alleged "lies and betrayal" and a rift over Article 370. Ruhullah is also expected to quit the National Conference party.
